parameters.help_en:
The type of resource. If you query the compliance evaluation results of resources by resource type, you must specify this parameter.

You can call the GetSupportedResourceTypes operation to query the resource types supported by Cloud Config. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169618.html.

You must specify the ResourceType or ConfigRuleId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。当您按资源类型查询资源评估结果时，必须配置该参数。

您可以通过GetSupportedResourceTypes接口获取配置审计支持的资源类型列表。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169618.html。

资源类型（ResourceType）和规则ID（ConfigRuleId）二选一

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resources are evaluated as compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: The resources are evaluated as non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resources.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: The resource data is insufficient
parameters.help_zh:
合规类型。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：数据不充分

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100

EvaluationResults.description_en: The information about the compliance evaluation results returned

EvaluationResultList.description_en:
Indicates whether remediation is enabled. Valid values:

true
false

Annotation.description_en: The annotation to the resource that is evaluated to be non-compliant
Annotation.description_zh: 不合规资源的补充信息

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation result of the resource. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is evaluated to be compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is evaluated to be non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: The resource data is insufficient
ComplianceType.description_zh:
合规类型。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：数据不充分

ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that was generated when the rule was triggered

EvaluationResultIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the compliance evaluation result

EvaluationResultQualifier.description_en: The information of the rule and the evaluated resource

ConfigRuleArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the rule

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the evaluated resource

ResourceName.description_en: The type of the evaluated resource

ResourceType.description_en: The type of the evaluated resource

OrderingTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that was generated when the compliance evaluation was performed

InvokingEventMessageType.description_en:
The trigger type of the rule. Valid values:

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: The rule is triggered by configuration changes.
ScheduledNotification: The rule is triggered as scheduled

规则的触发机制。取值：
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：配置变更。
ScheduledNotification：周期执行

RemediationEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the remediation template. Valid values:

true
false

true

false

ResultRecordedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that was generated when the compliance evaluation result was recorded

1: high risk
2: medium risk
3: low risk
